applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT) as amended, regulated by Decreto Ejecutivo No. 406 de 2015; Ley No. 254 de 2020 establishing the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Registry); Ley No. 32 de 1927 (General Law of Corporations) regarding corporate records; implementing rules of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and the Intendencia de Supervisión del Mercado de Valores.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Power of Attorney in favor of Panamanian registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the principal's jurisdiction
Attesting local notary or legal counsel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Quality Management System Certificate (ISO 13485) for Class III medical device manufacturer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Accredited certification body (e.g., notified body in country of origin)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory and continuous screening against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Panamanian Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) national warnings and disqualification lists. Enhanced due diligence and prior approval by the AML compliance officer are required for any PEP involvement, particularly because the business scope involves export-controlled Class III medical devices.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Online Name Reservation System (Sistema de Reserva de Nombre en Línea)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be composed of Latin-alphabet letters; if the desired name originates in a non-Latin script, a certified transliteration into Spanish or English is required. The name must include a suffix indicating limited liability: 'S.A.', 'Sociedad Anónima', or permitted abbreviation. Names must not be identical, confusingly similar, or misleadingly close to existing registrations in the same registry class; Spanish common nouns or names that could mislead as to the lawful corporate purpose are restricted.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within five (5) business days of service of the rejection resolution, the applicant may file a written reconsideration petition before the Director General of the Registro Público. If denied, a hierarchical appeal may be filed with the Superior Council of the Registro Público within five (5) business days. Final administrative decisions may be challenged before the Sala Tercera (Contencioso-Administrativa) of the Supreme Court of Justice. Name clearance must be obtained before notarization of the articles of incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may serve only as the registered agent's address for receipt of legal and administrative notices; it is not acceptable as the production, storage, or inspection site for a Class III drug-eluting stent manufacturer. The Ministry of Health (Minsa) and the Directorate of Drugs and Related Products require a physical manufacturing facility and local technical representative.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama Law 32 of 1927 (Ley 32 de 1927 sobre Sociedades Anónimas), as amended by Law 5 of 2014; applying Sections 1 through 72 on incorporation, capital, directors, and officers; subsidiary regulation under the Public Registry Rules of Law 18 of 2014.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas con Fines de Lucro (Mercantile Section), Republic of Panama
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública No. ____ (Public Deed of Incorporation) containing the Pacto Social and Estatutos, executed before a Panamanian Notary Public and recorded in the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital is freely determined and may be denominated in any convertible currency. A registration tax of approximately 1% of the subscribed capital (standard US$100 on a US$10,000 capital base) is payable at the Public Registry. No escrow or bank deposit account is required for a standard Sociedad Anónima.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED FIRST: The subscription of the Company's registered capital — 10,000 common shares at US$1.00 par value each, subscribed and paid by the incorporators — is approved and ratified. RESOLVED SECOND: The registered office is fixed at [address], Corregimiento de Bella Vista, Panamá, and the licensed resident agent [name] is designated to receive legal service of process. RESOLVED THIRD: [Name], [Name], and [Name] are appointed President, Treasurer, and Secretary, respectively, to hold office until the first annual general meeting. RESOLVED FOURTH: The President and Treasurer, jointly, are authorized to open bank accounts, execute banking documents, and take all acts necessary to commence the Company's corporate operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sistema de Reserva de Nombres (processed through an authorized Panamanian notary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation request listing three alternative corporate names in descending preference order through a Panamanian notary or the Public Registry's online reservation platform; pay the search tariff; obtain the Certificado de Reserva de Nombre, valid for 30 days, before drafting the public deed.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each incorporator
Three proposed corporate names with 'S.A.' suffix
Payment receipt of the name-search tariff
Power of attorney to the formation notary (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or conflicts with an existing entity, an available alternative from the reserved list is substituted and re-submitted; an administrative objection is available to the Dirección General del Registro Público against an improper refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Público del Circuito de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporators, or their attorneys-in-fact, appear before the notary and execute the Escritura Pública containing the Pacto Social and Estatutos, setting out the corporate purpose (manufacture of Class III coronary drug-eluting stents), capital structure, officers, resident agent clause, and fiscal year; the notary records the instrument in his or her protocol.
required_dossiers: Valid name reservation certificate
Passport copies and full legal names of the incorporators
Draft charter and bylaws in Spanish
Notarial fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies statutory defects such as an incompatible corporate-purpose clause or capital irregularity, the deed is revised and re-executed through a corrective amendment before the same notary before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Capital Registration Tax and Notarial Protocol Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Tesorería, or Banco Nacional de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Compute the registration tax at the statutory tariff on the declared subscribed capital (standard rate of approximately 1%; on US$10,000 of capital, US$100) plus the fixed Public Registry tariff; make payment at the authorized bank or Registry cashier and retain the original receipt for the inscription application.
required_dossiers: Protocol copy of the Escritura Pública
Capital declaration schedule
Payment receipt issued by the bank or Registry cashier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Underpayment is cured by paying the differential plus any applicable surcharge; overpayment is credited or refunded upon written application to the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas con Fines de Lucro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the duly notarized Escritura Pública, proof of payment of registration tax, and the Law 23 of 2015 AML/CFT due-diligence forms to the Mercantile Section. The Registrar reviews the legality of the instrument and issues the Certificado de Registro, which perfects the legal personality of the Sociedad Anónima.
required_dossiers: Executed Escritura Pública (protocol copy)
Receipt of registration tax payment
Name reservation certificate
Law 23 of 2015 AML/CFT client forms and source-of-funds statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon a 'nota de objeción', the notary executes a corrective amendment deed (escritura enmendatoria) addressing the Registrar's observations and resubmits the instrument; a formal appeal to the Registrador General is available within the legal term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration with the General Directorate of Revenue (RUC/NIT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) application identifying the legal representative, registered office, and the ISIC 3250 economic activity; receive the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) and, where applicable, request the digital signature certificate for electronic invoicing.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro issued by the Public Registry
Certified copy of the Escritura Pública
Passport and RUC of the legal representative and officers
Proof of registered-office address (lease agreement or public deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Inconsistencies in the sworn application are cured through a complementary filing with the DGI; a written rectification with supporting documents is submitted and processed through the DGI's mesa de entrada.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License (Patente Municipal) and Start-of-Operations Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá — Dirección de Rentas Municipales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Aviso de Operación to the municipality where the registered office and plant are located, declaring the Class III medical-device manufacturing activity; pay the proportional municipal patent tax for the fiscal year; obtain the Patente Municipal, a precondition for the physical plant to begin lawful operations.
required_dossiers: RUC/NIT certificate
Certificate of incorporation from the Public Registry
Lease agreement or title deed for the registered office and plant
Completed Aviso de Operación form and municipal tax payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected, correct the declared activity classification or the registered address and resubmit; late filing is cured by paying the municipal surcharge (recargo) and obtaining the patent retroactively.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Registro de Beneficiarios Finales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 calendar days after incorporation, file the sworn beneficial-ownership declaration identifying every individual who directly or indirectly holds or controls 10% or more of the shares, capital rights, or control rights of the entity; issue the statutory notice to each ultimate beneficial owner to confirm his or her particulars.
required_dossiers: Corporate data (RUC and Public Registry folio)
Ownership-chain diagram
Identification documents of ultimate beneficial owners
Sworn declaration signed by the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing is cured upon payment of the statutory surcharge under Law 70 of 2019; erroneous filings are corrected by filing an enmendatoria declaration before any inspection or audit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) — Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas (health registration and GMP), jointly with Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Dirección General de Empresas (industrial standards and investment facilitation)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivo Médico Clase III (Class III Medical Device Health Registration) and Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM) for the coronary drug-eluting stent manufacturing plant

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección Nacional de Evaluación y Seguimiento Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II — Semi-Detailed Environmental Impact Study (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental, EsIA) required under Law 41 of 1998 and Executive Decree 123 of 2009, given the use of solvents and polymer-coating chemicals and the generation of controlled liquid and hazardous wastes
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Process wastewater from acidic or alkaline cleaning baths and solvent rinses must meet Panama's national industrial discharge limits aligned with WHO and IFC EHS Guidelines for Pharmaceuticals; zero untreated process-water discharge to public sewer; VOC abatement for polymer-coating solvents must achieve ≥95% removal efficiency using carbon adsorption or equivalent control technology; hazardous wastes (etched metal residues, spent organic solvents, expired polymer resins) must be manifested, stored in compliant containers, and transported only by MiAMBIENTE-authorized carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Aprobación de Planos and Permiso de Funcionamiento Contra Incendios from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load inspection certificate for cleanroom and laser-machining equipment; building occupancy permit from the municipality; mandatory workplace safety and health program clearance from MITRADEL (Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral), including laser-safety audits, chemical-hygiene plans, and cleanroom occupational controls consistent with ISO 14644.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Autoridad Nacional de Ingresos Públicos (ANIP), the unified revenue authority under Law 279 of 2023 integrating the former Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) and the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (Customs). Taxpayer e-services portal: SISTAP (https://sistap.anip.gob.pa), used for RUC registration, electronic filing (SIAF), ITBMS returns, and e-invoice validation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) in the Registro Público de Panamá through a licensed resident attorney (abogado idóneo); the S.A. must keep a resident agent and a resident or fiscal representative; no minimum capital requirement applies. Step 2: Obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) from ANIP and complete the municipal Aviso de Operación (business operation notice). Step 3: Secure the MINSA sanitary registration and sanitary operating permit for Class III medical device manufacturing (mandatory prerequisite for ISIC 3250/NAICS 339112 before production starts). Step 4: Register as an ITBMS taxpayer, obtain the fiscal digital certificate (firma electrónica), and activate the Facturación Electrónica (electronic invoicing) authorization. Step 5: If exporting, register as an exporter (Registro de Exportador) with the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas and, if hiring employees, open the employer file with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation_with_Territorial_Scope; Tax_Exempt_Zone available under special regimes. A Panamanian S.A. is a juridical person taxed only on Panamanian-source income; foreign-source income is exempt by territoriality. No pass-through applies to the S.A.; shareholders are taxed on dividends paid from Panamanian-source profits (5% for registered shares, 10% for bearer shares, as applicable). Qualified operations may elect Tax_Exempt_Zone treatment under Panama Pacifico, Colon Free Zone, or Ciudad del Saber regimes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama has no US-style check-the-box and no statutory hybrid-mismatch entity elections; an S.A. is always treated as a taxable corporation. Available elections and special regimes: (i) Panama Pacifico Special Economic Area (Law 41 of 2004) and Colon Free Zone (Law 18 of 1948, as amended), granting ITBMS exemptions and substituting ISR with a fixed annual zone fee; (ii) Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM) regime (Law 41 of 2007) - services only, not applicable to manufacturing; (iii) Simplified pequeno contribuyente regime (Law 42 of 2017) for annual gross income up to USD 150,000; (iv) export promotion and drawback regimes under Panamanian export laws. Panama is an MLI signatory and applies territorial sourcing; no hybrid entity classifications are recognized absent specific anti-abuse findings.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) - Panamanian value-added tax on the transfer of movable goods and the supply of services in Panamanian territory; destination-based with zero-rating for exports. Standard general rate is 7%; Law 361 of 2023 introduced a selective 9% rate on digital/audiovisual services and certain luxury goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis threshold in PAB/USD: any person habitually performing taxable transfers of goods or services in Panama must register for ITBMS (Código Fiscal arts. 1058 et seq.). The optional simplified regime applies to 'pequeno contribuyente' taxpayers with annual gross income up to USD 150,000. Exporting manufacturers must also hold the customs Registro de Exportador linked to the same RUC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) administered by ANIP/DGI. All ITBMS-registered taxpayers must issue validated e-invoices through ANIP-certified issuers or direct API integration, transmit each document in real time to the ANIP validation platform, obtain a digital authorization number, and display a QR code. Export invoices must reference the export DUA and the zero-rate code. Non-validated invoices are inadmissible as documentary support for ITBMS input credits, refund claims, or customs clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Panama are zero-rated (0% ITBMS) provided the seller is an ITBMS registrant and the export is evidenced by a definitive export customs declaration (DUA) validated by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas. Services are zero-rated when rendered to a non-resident and economically consumed abroad (Código Fiscal art. 1059-G and Decreto 84 de 2005). For coronary drug-eluting stents, the manufacturer must demonstrate physical dispatch, MINSA-sanitary conformity, and absence of local consumption, and must operate in the general tax regime (free-zone exemption would disqualify ITBMS input credit recovery).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Única Aduanera (DUA) de exportación definitiva validated by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas
Electronic commercial invoice (Factura Electrónica) issued under the approved ANIP framework, expressly coded as zero-rated ITBMS 0%
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (conocimiento de embarque) issued to the foreign buyer naming the Panamanian S.A. as shipper
Banking inward remittance certificate (comprobante bancario de ingreso de divisas) evidencing collection from the foreign buyer
Packing list, certificate of origin, and MINSA Class III medical device sanitary certificate
Customs seal or export inspection report evidencing the physical exit of the goods from Panamanian territory
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ANIP audits cross-match DUA data, e-invoice metadata, shipping manifests, and banking inflows in USD to verify genuine export transactions. Discrepancies trigger retrospective assessment at 7% ITBMS with statutory delinquency interest, fines of up to 200% of the evaded tax under Código Fiscal arts. 1132-1134, clawback of any refund previously paid, cancellation of the customs exporter registration and the MINSA license, and criminal prosecution for defraudación tributaria (Código Fiscal art. 1134) carrying imprisonment in cases of intentional documentation fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco Nacional de Panamá (fiscal agent) and Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (banking supervisor); Panamá has no central bank, and the US dollar is legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panamá is a fully dollarized economy with no exchange-control law. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are freely convertible into US dollars, and profit remittances, dividends, and intra-group payments may be transferred offshore without exchange-control approval. The relevant limitations are tax-related, principally the Panamanian territorial income tax and withholding rules on dividends paid from Panama-source earnings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender rule or mandatory conversion ratio applies to export receipts. Exporters may retain 100% of USD proceeds in Panamanian banks, use them freely for payments, or remit them abroad without central-bank authorization, time limit, or conversion requirement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for offshore digital EMIs. An unlicensed offshore EMI cannot maintain a payment account or clear funds for a Panamanian corporate; holding client money or performing clearing without a banking or finance license violates Decreto Ley 2 de 2008. A foreign EMI may serve only as a limited remittance channel through a licensed Panamanian bank, and a Class III medical device manufacturer will still require a full local banking relationship for capital and trade settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for high-risk corporate clients. At least one beneficial owner or senior director must attend an in-person KYC interview at the Panamanian bank. Remote onboarding is not generally available for medical-device manufacturing entities, and it may be used only as a supplementary step after face-to-face verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk classification of Class III cardiovascular stent manufacturing and medical-device export flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO 13485 certificate, FDA/EU MDR registration or Panamanian Ministry of Health medical-device registration, audited proof of physical production facility, distributor agreements, customs and logistics records, and an independent AML risk assessment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived opacity of the Panamanian Sociedad Anónima and historic bearer-share risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized beneficial-ownership declaration covering the full chain, registered-agent certificate, bearer-share suppression/custody compliance certificate, economic-substance annual filing, board resolutions, and audited financial statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of initial capital injection in US dollars
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn capital-contribution resolution, bank reference letters from the parent jurisdiction, tax-residency certificates, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth affidavits, and the underlying share-subscription and purchase contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: US-correspondent banking, OFAC sanctions, and PEP exposure due to USD clearing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC/PEP screening results, beneficial-owner PEP declaration, enhanced due-diligence questionnaire, negative-media and adverse-data search, and written confirmation that all USD wires will settle through a vetted US correspondent banking chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity is cleared in USD via SWIFT MT103 to the Panamanian operating account, with settlement through the bank's US correspondent using CHIPS or Fedwire. Remittance Information (field 70) must state 'EQUITY CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION', and the category-purpose information should be mapped by the instructing bank to 'Equity Investment / Capital Contribution'. Verification requires the board/shareholder resolution, source-of-funds documentation, bank reference, UBO declaration, and completed OFAC/PEP screening. No currency conversion is required because the US dollar is the domestic legal tender.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are executed through irrevocable documentary letters of credit (SWIFT MT700) and SWIFT MT103 for open-account settlements; MT202/MT210 are used for correspondent clearing. Payments to Asian and Latin American suppliers of bioresorbable polymers, cobalt-chromium alloys, and packaging are made in USD, EUR, or CNH subject to compliance review of the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, bill of lading, and Panamanian customs/health-control confirmations. No FX approval is required, but sanctions and PEP screening apply to every wire and LC.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR FX forward with a licensed Panamanian bank
Deliverable USD/CNH FX forward settled offshore in offshore Chinese yuan
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not applicable because Panama maintains full US-dollar convertibility without capital controls

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax (Tasa Anual de Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama Tax Administration (Dirección General de Ingresos, DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March of each calendar year; no anniversary-based extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues statutory interest of 10% per month or fraction of a month, capped at 100% of the tax due; repeated non-payment for three consecutive years subjects the S.A. to administrative strike-off proceedings by the Public Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama Tax Administration (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year S.A.: on or before 31 March of the following fiscal year; for fiscal-year S.A.: within three months after fiscal year-end; not required where the S.A. derives no Panamanian-source income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due per month of delay, up to 50%, plus statutory interest; failure to file may block issuance of tax clearance certificates and subject directors to administrative fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Confirmation and Amendment Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) through the registered agent; Public Registry where UBO annotations are required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually upon the company's anniversary confirmation cycle and within 30 calendar days after any transfer of shares or change in ultimate beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation is treated as an AML compliance violation under Law 70 of 2017, exposing the S.A. to administrative fines; persistent failure blocks registry transactions and may lead to the registered agent resigning and the company being flagged for strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for a private S.A. where annual Panamanian-source gross receipts exceed USD 300,000; mandatory irrespective of revenue for publicly listed securities issuers, banks, insurers, financial and trust licensees, and entities whose sector regulator (e.g., MINSA for Class III medical device manufacturers) requires an approved auditor
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Panama Accounting Standards Board; statutory books maintained in balboas/USD, with Spanish-language ledgers or authorized bilingual records

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent issues an annual UBO confirmation statement on the company's anniversary; directors and shareholders must re-certify within 30 days. Every share transfer or beneficial ownership change must be documented in the share-transfer ledger and reported to the registered agent within 30 days. The registered agent then updates the UBO record with the Public Registry/UAF, and the transfer is recorded only after all annual franchise tax and corporate fees are settled.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 12,000 per year when an audit is required; not incurred if the S.A. is below the statutory audit threshold with no Panamanian-source activity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat corporate income tax (ISR) on net Panama-source income under the general regime; no canton/municipal corporate income tax layer.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territoriality: foreign-source revenues (e.g., export sales booked through a genuine offshore pass-through structure) remain outside Panamanian ISR; qualifying medical-device exporters can apply for a stability contract under 'CEM' export-development regimes (Law 28/1995 framework) granting 100% ISR exemption on incremental export income and duty/VAT-free import of production equipment, pending DGI approval.
